verdict.rationale: Svelte's compiler-based architecture (svelte-gh-1, svelte-docs-4) and lightweight output support embedding in small parts of an app, and 'sv add' (svelte-docs-14) lets you add Svelte functionality to an existing project, while SvelteKit supports both SPA and SSG deployment modes (svelte-docs-16, svelte-docs-17). However, no evidence explicitly demonstrates dropping a single Svelte component into a non-Svelte page or scaling from a widget to a full app. Missing for 10: explicit incremental-adoption guide/tutorial, hands-on example of embedding into an existing non-Svelte site, independent corroboration of gradual migration success.
